patterns: APPSC asks direct items: Green Revolution mainly wheat and rice, NFSM 2007 = rice, wheat, pulses, BGREI = paddy, rice-wheat is the dominant cropping system, Assam shifting cultivation = Jhoom.

APPSC Group-1 uses statement items with a trap (black soil of Deccan 'not suitable' for wheat is the wrong one) and 4-way match of shifting-cultivation names (Ladang-Indonesia, Milpa-Central America, Roca-Brazil, Masole-Central Africa).
Leading-state questions recur (rice WB, wheat UP, jowar, pulses MP), but keys date to their exam year and drift over time.
Other PSCs heavily test crop seasons (gram/mustard rabi, fodder zaid), crop varieties and research institute locations.
App MCQs lean on 2025-26 schemes and data (NFSNM, Dalhan Mission, NMEO, PMFBY) and multi-statement formats; core season/region facts match PYQs.
